evanāmaka: [ evaṃ + nāma + ka.] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī evaṃnāmikā.] One who has this name.
evapabhāva: [ evaṃ + pabhāva ] (ti) CL=7 Having such a power.
evapakāra: [ evaṃ + pakāra ] (ti) CL=7 (1) With such a manner. Which is similar to such (an ahosikamma).
evapakāsitanāma: [ evaṃpakāsita + nāma ] (ti) CL=7 With an obvious name which should be shown like this.
evapasanna: [ evaṃ + pasanna ] (ti) CL=7 Having such faith. One who has such faith.
evapavatta: [ evaṃ + pavatta ] (ti) CL=7 Arises or becomes like this.
evapañña: [ evaṃ + paññā ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such an intelligence.
evapaṇḍita: [ evaṃ + paṇḍita ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such an intelligence. See - Evaṃdhīra.
evapūtikasabhāva: [ evaṃ + pūtikasabhāva ] (ti) CL=7 Having such a rotten nature.
evarajanīya: [ evaṃ + rajanīya ] (ti) CL=7 So desirable. See - Evaṃ-kamanīya.
evasabhāva: [ evaṃ + sabhāva ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such a nature.
evasammata: [ evaṃ + sammata ] (ti) CL=7 One who should be known as a wholesome person. See - Evaṃdhīra.
evasampada: [ evaṃ + sampadā ] (ti) CL=7 Having such a nature. Having such accomplished. With a simile of accomplishment.
evasaññita: [ evaṃ + saññita ] (ti) CL=7 Should be perceived like that.
evasaññā: [ evaṃ + saññā ] (thī) CL=7 (1) This kind of perception. (Ti) (2) One who has this kind of perception.
evasaññī: [ evaṃsaññā + ī ] (ti) CL=7 One who has this kind of perception.
evasaṅkhāra: [ evaṃ + saṅkhāra ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such kind of mental faculty (Saṅkhārakkhandhā). See - Evaṃrūpa.
evasaṇṭhāna: [ evaṃ + saṇṭhāna ] (ti) CL=7 Having such an appearance. See - Evaṃvaṇṇappaṭibhāga.
evasiloka: [ evaṃ + siloka ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such a reputation. See - Evaṃsadda.
evasukhadukkhappaṭisavedī: [ evaṃ + sukha dukkha + paṭisaṃvedī ] (ti) CL=7 One who used to experience such pleasure and pain.
evasīla: [ evaṃ + sīla ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such virtues.
evavadanasabhāva: [ evaṃvadana + sabhāva ] (ti) CL=7 One who has the nature of such appearance.
evavaṇṇa: [ evaṃ + vaṇṇa ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such appearance.
evavaṇṇappaṭibhāga: [ evaṃ + vaṇṇappaṭibhāga ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Having such form and extent that has been shown, (2) Having such form. (3) Similar to such form.
evavedana: [ evaṃ + vedanā ] (ti) CL=7 One who has this kind of sensation. See - Evaṃrūpa.
evavidha: [ evaṃ + vidha ] (ti) CL=7 (A) Having such a nature. (B) Having such kinds of.
evavidhaguṇa: [ evaṃvidha + guṇa ] (pu) CL=7 The qualities that have such kinds of.
evavidhaparaloka: [ evaṃvidha + paraloka ] (ti) CL=7 Having such kinds of next destination.
evavihārī: [ evaṃ + vi + hara + ṇī ] (ti) CL=7 One who used to live in this way.
evavimutta: [ evaṃ + vimutta ] (ti) CL=7 One who is liberated in a such way.
evavipāka: [ evaṃ + vipāka ] (ti) CL=7 Having such benefit.
evavisesa: [ evaṃ + visesa ] (ti) CL=7 Having such a superior state.
evavividhasukhadukkhāvaha: [ evaṃvividhasukhadukkha + āvaha ] (ti) CL=7 Brings or carries a variety of pleasure and pain. See - Evaṃvipāka.
evaviññāṇa: [ evaṃ + viññāṇa ] (ti) CL=7 He has such a mind. Evidence - See.
evavutta: [ evaṃ + vutta ] (ti) CL=7 Should be preached by the power of showing the special function of such saddāekaggata.
evavādī: [ evaṃvāda + ī.] (ti) CL=7 [Evaṃ + vada + ṇī. ] (A) One who takes such doctrine, (B) One who used to speech like that.
evaācāra: [ evaṃ + ācāra ] (ti) CL=7 One who has such a habit. See - Evācāra.
